content: Yowbad nitun ya̱kids

Kuninuways guyaw teitan igaw wagwa̱din bikow nakiyay, na-ikadilok bikaleiwag; magina tamwey teitan natouwat towen. Kadan o taman teitan bikaleiwag. Igaw anatut bivakaein, gwad towen mo bikow nakaleiwag tonen, peinan taman kweiboug nilivnek ilana, “Igaw tutan waseg mo bikow nakaleiwag.”

O ya̱kids ma̱wan. Kweiboug mamagina daGeileiws sitouwat ya̱kids; tut gog towen nitamlavags Yowbad nitun. Igaw wagwa̱dids nitakawes daGeileiws nakaleiwag ee... misiya̱mun towen bo ikadilok Yowbad waseg, mo ikayeb Natun, im watinow wasigeis tasiyas takaweins Moses nakaleiwag. Kuda̱vin na̱tan ikop mo imlavag gamag, va̱gan biymiyiseid angamag ya̱kids, bitalisawes Moses nakaleiwag mo bitamlavags Yowbad nitun ya̱kids.
Mapuna isekeids Natun kululuwan, ilana, “Tamad!” Ya̱kids mo talansa, “Tamad!”
Nag magina kweiboug kaleiwag natouwat ya̱kids, nag. Yowbad nitun ya̱kids. O peinan Yowbad nitun ya̱kids mo isekeids dakiyays.
Pawl ikalin nuwan min-Galetiy wasigeis
Kweiboug nag kukwakins Yowbad. Tobwag yowbad natouwat yakamiy. Tasiyas nag mounid yowbad tasiyas; nag. Iyyaweids-wan.
Nagein gog bo kukwakins Yowbad, o togo mamagina ikakin yakamiy. Aveiyag wawun nukuyums kunekes amiGeileiw kweiboug? Tougweys o tasimavs tasiyas. Sivinamiy kid bukuwgavaws siwotet tasiyas. Bo igak!
Ma̱wan amiGeileiw kweiboug kuvna̱ses min-Yudiy sikaleiwag, magina kuvna̱ses yam mwasinis o tibukon mwasinis o wuwal o bulbweilim wasigeis.
Bo igeg nanoug. Adok bo awoteta mav wasigeis yakamiy.
Sigwey, bo amlavag ma̱wana yakamiy. Singay sivinag bukumlavags ma̱wana yey. Nag kuygageigs, nag. Wanmugwana agukwatoun mo asekeimiy liva̱nen Yeisuw; tage ta-kupiyaveigs, nag.
Ta-kukwasigumigs peinan woug kalbaleb, nag. Nukutams waseg yey mamagina gum-liba̱lab yey, o mamagina Yeisuw Kelis tonen.
Adok kunuwes singay nitamsa̱mwas sigwey yakamiy. Tut kweiboug magat kadilokeimiy bukugutes mitamiy bukusekeigs silma̱nin matag, peinan singay nukusiwyoubugs yey; tut gog towen bo kwamliweigs.
Adok nukwamliweigs peinan agulivan mounid wasigeis yakamiy.
Bo adibakeimiy liva̱nen tasiyas niwekeimiy. Tasiyas ivag sivinamiy, tage tayyaweids tasiyas. Sivines kid bukupiyaves gunakaleiwag, va̱gan beivag kid sivinamiy sikaleiwag tasiyas.

Magat asisinap bwein, bweina bikaveiyons wasigeis yakamiy, tutan yey sigwey yakamiy tasesus, o tutan yey nases kweitan ven. Yakamiy mamagina nitug yakamiy. Bo igeg nanoug pinamiy. Igaw bukumlavags mamagina Kelis mo beitaw nuwag.
Tage ivag sivinag sigwey yakamiy bitasesus, bagilagel wasigeis yakamiy. Tut towen bo ikubukub nuwag pinamiy yakamiy.
Egal nag ma̱wan Sela
Yakamiy sivinamiy bukukwawes Moses nakaleiwag. Adok nag kuliganes kaleiwag towen.

Bukitab waseg liva̱nen Ebelam nises. Nakwav Sela vinakal. Nayuwein vin Sela natouwat yagan Egal. Egal won bwanabwein; ikop natun kuda̱taw. Sela vinakal, natun nag. Yowbad ilivnek, mo ikop natun yagan Aysak.

Kabebay nises wasigeis vinay tasiyas asteiy. Vinay asteiy mamagina kaleiwag akweiy. Egal mamagina Moses nakaleiwag. Koy yagan Sinay ven Alebiy waseg, Moses bo ikow kaleiwag towen, isekes min-Yudiys. E, min-Yudiys siven Yelusalem, igawa ivvaluts sikaleiwag moumouvit waseg, mamagina sinya̱wan tasiyas.
Ya̱kids dakaleiwags kweitan meinoy neim walba̱lab, mamagina davanuys Yelusalem kweitan, walba̱lab nises. Ya̱kids nag ma̱wan sinya̱wan, bwein-wan ya̱kids, mamagina Sela nitun ya̱kids.
Bweina tamwa̱saws, tasiyas nag. Livan nises Bukitab waseg mamagina:

content.text: Natum nag; tage bweina kuwak, kumwa̱saw.

content: Yakamiy ma̱wana yakamey, Yowbad nitun babaw ya̱kids. Kweiboug ilivnek mo Sela ikop natun Aysak. Ya̱kids ma̱wan, anilivan mounid ilivnek mo nitamlavags nitun Yowbad, ya̱kids.

Egal ikop natun won tatonen waseg. Sela ikop natun peinan Yowbad ilivnek; kululuwan ileb mo ikop natun Aysak. Wankuyeim Egal natun mo ikamliw Aysak. Ma̱wan magin takanaweins Moses nakaleiwag mo ikamliweids tut towen waseg.
Ikamliweids; nag gog, peinan kweitan livan nises Bukitab waseg, mamagina:

content.text: Mukwav tonen natun bikow mukiyay meivek-wan.”

content: Ya̱kids nag ma̱wan Egal nitun, nag. Ya̱kids ma̱wana Sela nitun; dakiyays mounid nises.
